title: NimbusDesk Getting Started Guide
content: This guide walks new NimbusDesk administrators through initial setup: creating a workspace, inviting team members, connecting a web chat widget, and configuring your first agent. Most teams complete onboarding in under 30 minutes. After setup, we recommend importing existing FAQs and enabling the RAG-based knowledge search so agents can answer common questions automatically.

title: Billing & Subscription Plans
content: NimbusDesk bills monthly or annually in advance. Upgrading a plan takes effect immediately with a prorated charge; downgrading takes effect at the next billing cycle. Enterprise customers can request a custom contract with invoicing instead of credit-card billing. All plan changes are logged in the account audit trail.

title: Security & Compliance Overview
content: NimbusDesk (fictional, for demo purposes) describes a typical SaaS security posture: encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access control, audit logging of administrative actions, and regular third-party penetration testing. Customer data is logically isolated per workspace. No real compliance certifications are claimed by this demo project.

title: API Rate Limits & Quotas
content: The NimbusDesk API enforces a default limit of 60 requests per minute per API key, with burst tolerance up to 120 requests. Enterprise plans can request a higher quota. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header indicating when to resume.

title: Data Export & Retention Policy
content: Conversation and customer data is retained for 24 months by default and can be exported at any time as CSV or JSON. Deleted workspaces enter a 30-day recovery window before permanent deletion. Retention windows are configurable on Enterprise plans to meet internal data governance requirements.
